title: 3–2 control-solenoid circuit fault
plainEnglishMeaning: The PCM detected an electrical problem involving the 3–2 control-solenoid circuit.
failureCriteria: Exact application-specific feedback criteria are not yet verified.

likelyCauses.cause: Poor contact at a transmission connector
Open ignition-feed circuit or fuse problem
Short in the internal transmission harness

falsePositiveConditions: A shared ignition-feed fault can set multiple solenoid codes at once.
confirmatoryTests: Check for other transmission electrical codes that share the ignition feed.
Verify power at the 3–2 control-solenoid circuit.
Test the internal harness and solenoid for an open or short.
